0.0: While the current Tempest festival doesn't compare to the well-groomed, opulent growth of hair above my upper lip, I think it deserves SOME recognition, don't you?

yes.0: I've decided to give a #rTempest Coin Pouch#k to anyone who can clear Monster Park #ethree times#n in a single day. I've stowed all sorts of junk, I mean, treasures insides these pouches, not merely Tempest Coins...

no.0: You think my mustache outshines the Tempest Festival? I can't say I disagree...

default.0: You shall get from me a Tempest Coin Pouch if you clear Monster Park #ethree times#n in one day. And I shall get from you...massive entertainment. I'd say it's a fair trade.
